title: Progressive delivery telemetry & redaction playbook for incremental outputs
creator: Asha Kumar
description: Motivation: the runtime now emits partial responses for progressive delivery (tool calls, structured fragments, and long-form generation). We need a unified, operational playbook to capture per-emission metrics, attach short-lived tracing spans, and apply deterministic redaction before logs/metrics leave the cluster. Scope: define telemetry contract for 'emission' (an atomic incremental output unit), implement EmitSpan lifecycle instrumentation in the runtime, add conservative redaction hooks (token/window-aware scrub), extend ingestion pipeline to accept emission-level events, and provide dashboards + runbook for SRE/SEs. Must preserve backward compatibility for clients that expect non-streamed responses and not degrade P95 latencies for latency-sensitive routes.
acceptance_criteria: Define 'emission' schema and field semantics (index, type, bytes, tokens, parent_request_id, model_version, route)
Runtime emits telemetry events for each emission with stable tags: request_id, emission_index, emission_stage (start|flush|end), model, node_id
Tracing: each emission creates a child span that links to request-level trace and is visible in traces (start/finish + error tags)
Redaction: emitted payloads are scrubbed according to the redaction policy prior to leaving the runtime; raw payloads never persisted in plain text in primary telemetry Kafka topic
Compatibility: clients that disable streaming (compat flag) receive assembled final output and we still generate equivalent emission telemetry (assembled_emission) for parity
Dashboards: Grafana panels for per-route emission rate, per-emission latency histogram, emission error breakdown, and privacy-redaction hit-rate
Integration tests and load tests validating telemetry under realistic batching (1k rps) and burst patterns
Documentation: Confluence playbook + example queries for SRE (logs/metrics/traces) and a public SDK note for customers about observability fields
implementation_notes: Telemetry contract: emission_id = {request_id}:{emission_index}, emission_index starts at 0 for the first partial fragment
Metric primitives: counter(emissions.emitted), meter(emission_rate by route/model), histogram(emission_latency_ms), gauge(current_inflight_emissions)

Tracing: create EmitSpan with tags {emission_index, emission_bytes, emission_tokens, emission_type}; span lifetime = from emission_start->emission_flush; record error tag on failure to write to client or downstream tool call

Redaction: implement layered scrubbers: 1) token-pattern mask (emails/SSNs), 2) context-aware removal for tool-call inputs, 3) entropy-based masking for high-entropy tokens; config-driven per-route allowlist/denylist

Ingestion pipeline: augment existing telemetry pipeline (kafka topic 'telemetry-emissions') with a consumer that writes to metrics store (Prometheus via pushgateway) and to tracing backend (jaeger/opentelemetry), ensure sampling controls at ingestion layer
Compatibility layer: for 'compat: true' clients aggregate emissions end-to-end, emit a synthetic emission with type 'assembled' that carries assembled size and assembly_latency_ms

Privacy-first default: by default, only metadata and redacted text are written to long-term storage; raw payloads retained only in ephemeral encrypted buffer for <2 hours for replay-based debugging and access requires SRE-approved ticket
Performance: avoid sync writes when emitting telemetry — use lock-free ring buffer; telemetry batching should be aligned with token flush boundaries to avoid latency regression
Rollout: dark-launch telemetry in staging, then prod with sampling=5% for 24 hours, increase to 25% + enable dashboards, then 100% with redaction enforcement
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (staging): implement contract and unit tests; dark-launch emission events to staging telemetry topic
Phase 1 (canary): enable 5% sampling in prod for low-traffic route /v1/chat/fast; monitor emission latency and trace linkage for 48h
Phase 2 (expanded): 25% of traffic across two regions; validate redaction hit-rate and false-positive masking via manual review dataset
Phase 3 (full): 100% on all streaming routes + compatibility-assembling for flagged non-streaming clients; enable retention/archival rules
Rollback triggers: P95 emission latency increase > 15% for a route, redaction false-positive rate > 5% on sampled dataset, or >0.1% privacy-alert escalations
